integrity.proof_basis: Exact conditional-volume disintegration, two beta distributions, algebraic covariance diagonalization, asymptotic determinant.
integrity.reproduction: Run Python 3 checker.py; source code is embedded with the result.

scientific_limitations: Only the standard-example poset with nonmatching comparabilities and n>=2; the metric is the standard full-coordinate Euclidean one.
The previously established volume formula and general order-polytope triangulation are not asserted as novel.
Uninspected earlier equivalent moment formulas may exist; historical priority is provisional.
The exact rational formulas are analytically proved for all integers n>=2; the independent checker only enumerates n=2,3,4.
title: Exact covariance spectrum and beta sampling of the standard-example order polytope
